comments.author: @broimnotyourbro
comments.text: “As I unfortunately learned this year, we Windows users are second-class citizens.” You’re just now figuring this out? (Kidding.) The real bummer is that top-of-the-line Windows systems are at a severe disadvantage with local AI as well. Despite Nvidia GPUs being dramatically more powerful than even the fastest M-series GPU, they are so hobbled in terms of VRAM that they can’t run large models effectively. On my 4090/i9 with 128GB RAM I’m getting < 1 token per second with the llama3:70b, on my Mac Studio with an M2 Ultra it’s about as fast as GPT4. Annoying, shouldn’t be true, but will remain so as long as Nvidia doesn’t want to cannibalize sales of their $25K+ server-class GPUs by putting a usable amount of VRAM into their high-end consumer GPUs.
